product_summary: Website adinternational.in (Udaipur, Rajasthan; family business since 2016, Mr. Ashish Kumar Jain) presents itself as an exporter/trader of Indian natural and engineered stone. Listed lines: granite (North and South Indian varieties — Alaska White, Alaska Gold, Azul Nova, Ash Black, New Imperial Red, Jhansi Red, Rosy Pink, Crystal Yellow), marble (all marbles + 'exotic materials'), quartzites, engineered stone / quartz slabs, porcelain slabs, sandstone, limestone, slatestone, travertine, onyx, and industrial minerals (soapstone, talc, dolomite, quartz powder and lumps, bentonite powder, china clay). Finished forms offered: countertops, flooring, steps & risers, driveway/patio stone, monumental slabs, ready-made tombstones, raw blocks, cut-to-size tiles. Also advertises 'Precision Tile' / tiles and countertops as separate service blocks.
role_hint: trader (self-described: 'Our company is involved in the trading of all types of Indian natural & engineered stones'; family-owned export house, no processing plant claimed on site)
comment: Declared codes cover only part of the real product range. 2516.12 (granite blocks/slabs) and 6802.21 (worked marble) are consistent with the site's granite-block and marble-slab/countertop/tombstone lines — partial match. 2515.20 (ecaussine/alabaster) is NOT corroborated: the site lists no ecaussine or alabaster product; the closest real lines are sandstone/limestone/slatestone/travertine/onyx, which belong to 2515.20 only for monumental/building stone in crude form and to 6802.2x/6802.93 when worked — the declared code is therefore unverified for this company's actual assortment. Major product lines MISSING from the declaration: worked granite articles (6802.23 — countertops, cut-to-size tiles, steps/risers, tombstones), industrial minerals (soapstone/talc 2526.20, dolomite 2518, quartz 2506.20, bentonite 2508.10, china clay 2507.00), engineered quartz slabs (6810.99), and porcelain/ceramic tiles (6907.2x). Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a misclassification of an industry: the company is a natural-stone / industrial-minerals exporter-trader, not a construction or DIY retailer — the correct industry label is stone trading & export (B2B), with a secondary industrial-minerals line. Trader signs: explicit self-description as a trading company, no manufacturing/processing facility described, wide multi-origin assortment (North + South Indian granite, exotic materials) typical of a merchant exporter. All product claims are from the company's own website only — no customs line was available in this task, so every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rules the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, codes to be corrected/extended to the actual assortment. Note: sub-pages (/products/, /about-us/, /industrial-minerals/, sitemap.xml) returned 404 and the search backend was unavailable, so the catalogue could not be read line-by-line; findings rest on the homepage text. No registry, revenue or shipment data researched (out of scope).
